title: A Non-November
summary:
A Non-November
The VLCC spot market has followed up on a very strong third quarter with an extremely weak fourth quarter to-date. Strong summer rates, at a time of the year when rates have been relatively weak historically, may have created some false hope about the freight prospects for the end of the year. There was much reason to believe that this year's fourth quarter was poised to be just as strong as 2004 and 2005.
